name: hone-claws
short_effect: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.
flavor: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

name: dragon-claw
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flavor: Slashes the foe with sharp claws.

name: psyshock
short_effect: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.
flavor: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

name: calm-mind
short_effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.
flavor: Raises SP. ATK and SP. DEF by focusing the mind.

name: roar
short_effect: Immediately ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
flavor: Scares wild foes to end battle.

name: toxic
short_effect: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.
flavor: A poison move with increasing damage.

name: hail
short_effect: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.
flavor: Summons a hailstorm that strikes every turn.

name: bulk-up
short_effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
flavor: Bulks up the body to boost both ATTACK and DEFENSE.

name: venoshock
short_effect: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.
flavor: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

name: hidden-power
short_effect: Power and type depend upon user’s IVs.  Power can range from 30 to 70.
flavor: The power varies with the POKéMON.

name: sunny-day
short_effect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
flavor: Boosts fire-type moves for 5 turns.

name: taunt
short_effect: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.
flavor: Taunts the foe into only using attack moves.

name: ice-beam
short_effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
flavor: An attack that may freeze the foe.

name: blizzard
short_effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
flavor: An attack that may freeze the foe.

name: hyper-beam
short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
flavor: 1st turn: Attack 2nd turn: Rest

name: light-screen
short_effect: Reduces damage from special attacks by 50% for five turns.
flavor: Ups SPCL.DEF with a wall of light.

name: protect
short_effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
flavor: Foils attack that turn. It may fail.

name: rain-dance
short_effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.
flavor: Boosts water-type moves for 5 turns.

name: telekinesis
short_effect: Moves have 100% accuracy against the target for three turns.
flavor: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

name: safeguard
short_effect: Protects the user’s field from major status ailments and confusion for five turns.
flavor: Prevents all status problems.

name: frustration
short_effect: Power increases as happiness decreases, up to a maximum of 102.
flavor: An attack based on lack of loyalty.

name: solar-beam
short_effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
flavor: 1st turn: Prepare 2nd turn: Attack

name: smack-down
short_effect: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.
flavor: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

name: thunderbolt
short_effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
flavor: An attack that may cause paralysis.

name: thunder
short_effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
flavor: An attack that may cause paralysis.

name: earthquake
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
flavor: Tough but useless vs. flying foes.

name: return
short_effect: Power increases with happiness, up to a maximum of 102.
flavor: An attack that is based on loyalty.

name: dig
short_effect: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
flavor: 1st turn: Burrow 2nd turn: Attack

name: psychic
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
flavor: An attack that may lower SPCL.DEF.

name: shadow-ball
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
flavor: An attack that may lower SPCL.DEF.

name: brick-break
short_effect: Destroys Reflect and Light Screen.
flavor: Destroys barriers such as REFLECT and causes damage.

name: double-team
short_effect: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.
flavor: Heightens evasive­ ness.

name: reflect
short_effect: Reduces damage from physical attacks by half.
flavor: Raises DEFENSE with a barrier.

name: sludge-wave
short_effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
flavor: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

name: flamethrower
short_effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
flavor: An attack that may inflict a burn.

name: sludge-bomb
short_effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
flavor: An attack that may poison the foe.

name: sandstorm
short_effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.
flavor: Inflicts damage every turn.

name: fire-blast
short_effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
flavor: An attack that may cause a burn.

name: rock-tomb
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
flavor: Stops the foe from moving with rocks and cuts SPEED.

name: aerial-ace
short_effect: Never misses.
flavor: An extremely speedy and unavoidable attack.

name: torment
short_effect: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.
flavor: Torments the foe and stops successive use of a move.

name: facade
short_effect: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
flavor: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

name: flame-charge
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.
flavor: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.

name: rest
short_effect: User sleeps for two turns, completely healing itself.
flavor: Sleep for 2 turns to fully recover.

name: attract
short_effect: Target falls in love if it has the opposite gender, and has a 50% chance to refuse attacking the user.
flavor: Makes the opposite gender infatuated.

name: thief
short_effect: Takes the target’s item.
flavor: An attack that may steal a held item.

name: low-sweep
short_effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
flavor: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.

name: round
short_effect: Has double power if it’s used more than once per turn.
flavor: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

name: echoed-voice
short_effect: Power increases by 100% for each consecutive use by any friendly Pokémon, to a maximum of 200.
flavor: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

name: overheat
short_effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
flavor: Allows a full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.

name: ally-switch
short_effect: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.
flavor: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

name: focus-blast
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
flavor: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

name: energy-ball
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
flavor: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

name: false-swipe
short_effect: Cannot lower the target’s HP below 1.
flavor: Leaves the foe with at least 1HP.

name: scald
short_effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
flavor: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: fling
short_effect: Throws held item at the target; power depends on the item.
flavor: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

name: charge-beam
short_effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
flavor: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: sky-drop
short_effect: Carries the target high into the air, dodging all attacks against either, and drops it next turn.
flavor: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

name: incinerate
short_effect: Destroys the target’s held berry.
flavor: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

name: quash
short_effect: Makes the target act last this turn.
flavor: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

name: will-o-wisp
short_effect: Burns the target.
flavor: Inflicts a burn on the foe with intense fire.

name: acrobatics
short_effect: Has double power if the user has no held item.
flavor: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

name: embargo
short_effect: Target cannot use held items.
flavor: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

name: explosion
short_effect: User faints.
flavor: Very powerful but makes user faint.

name: shadow-claw
short_effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
flavor: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: payback
short_effect: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.
flavor: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

name: retaliate
short_effect: Has double power if a friendly Pokémon fainted last turn.
flavor: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.

name: giga-impact
short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
flavor: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

name: rock-polish
short_effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
flavor: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

name: flash
short_effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.
flavor: Blinds the foe to reduce accuracy.

name: stone-edge
short_effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
flavor: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: volt-switch
short_effect: User must switch out after attacking.
flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: thunder-wave
short_effect: Paralyzes the target.
flavor: A move that may cause paralysis.

name: gyro-ball
short_effect: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
flavor: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

name: swords-dance
short_effect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.
flavor: A dance that in­ creases ATTACK.

name: struggle-bug
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
flavor: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets’ Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

name: psych-up
short_effect: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.
flavor: Copies the foe's stat changes.

name: bulldoze
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
flavor: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon’s Speed stat is reduced.

name: frost-breath
short_effect: Always scores a critical hit.
flavor: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

name: rock-slide
short_effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
flavor: An attack that may cause flinching.

name: x-scissor
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flavor: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

name: dragon-tail
short_effect: Ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
flavor: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: work-up
short_effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.
flavor: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

name: poison-jab
short_effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
flavor: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

name: dream-eater
short_effect: Only works on sleeping Pokémon.  Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
flavor: Steals HP from a sleeping victim.

name: grass-knot
short_effect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
flavor: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

name: swagger
short_effect: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages and confuses the target.
flavor: Causes confusion and raises ATTACK.

name: pluck
short_effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
flavor: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

name: u-turn
short_effect: User must switch out after attacking.
flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: substitute
short_effect: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.
flavor: Makes a decoy with 1/4 user's max HP.

name: flash-cannon
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
flavor: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

name: trick-room
short_effect: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.
flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

name: wild-charge
short_effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
flavor: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.

name: rock-smash
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
flavor: An attack that may lower DEFENSE.

name: snarl
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
flavor: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target’s Sp. Atk stat decrease.

name: cut
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flavor: A basic attack. It can be used to cut down thin trees and grass.

name: fly
short_effect: User flies high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
flavor: 1st turn: Fly 2nd turn: Attack

name: surf
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
flavor: A strong water- type attack.

name: strength
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flavor: A powerful physi­ cal attack.

name: waterfall
short_effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
flavor: An aquatic charge attack.

name: dive
short_effect: User dives underwater, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
flavor: Dives underwater the first turn and strikes next turn.
